  g.adj.size

  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

  -- But since we pass adjacency list, we can just say "w s.t. has_edge"

  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w >= 0

  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

def HasNatPathWeight (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧
    g.path_has_weight p (n : Int)

lemma path_has_weight_exists (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ p, g.is_path p → ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by

  induction p with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      simp [WeightedGraph.is_path] at h
  | cons u tail ih =>
      intro h
      cases tail with
      | nil =>
          exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      | cons v rest =>
          have hedge : ∃ w, g.has_edge u v w := by
            have h0 := h.2 0 (by simp)
            simpa [List.getD] using h0
          have htail : g.is_path (v :: rest) := by
            constructor
            · simp
            · intro i hi
              have horig := h.2 (i + 1) (by
                simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
                omega)
              simpa [List.getD, Nat.add_assoc] using horig
          rcases hedge with ⟨we, he⟩
          rcases ih htail with ⟨wr, hr⟩
          exact ⟨we + wr, ⟨we, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩⟩

    (h_nonneg : g.weights_non_negative) :
    ∀ p w, g.path_has_weight p w → 0 ≤ w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      intro w h
      simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h
      omega
  | cons u tail ih =>
      cases tail with
      | nil =>
          intro w h
          simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h
          omega
      | cons v rest =>
          intro w h
          rcases h with ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, rfl⟩
          have hwe : 0 ≤ we := h_nonneg u v we hedge
          have hwr : 0 ≤ wr := ih wr hrest
          omega

    (h_nonneg : g.weights_non_negative) {start target : Nat}
    (h_reachable : Reachable g start target) :
    ∃ n, HasNatPathWeight g start target n := by
  rcases h_reachable with ⟨p, hp, hhead, hlast⟩
  rcases path_has_weight_exists g p hp with ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hw_nonneg : 0 ≤ w :=
    path_has_weight_nonnegative g h_nonneg p w hw
  refine ⟨w.toNat, p, hp, hhead, hlast, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hw_nonneg] using hw

    (h_nonneg : g.weights_non_negative) (start target : Nat)
    (h_reachable : Reachable g start target) : Int := by
  classical

    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : List (Option Int) :=

    (h_reachable : Reachable g start target) :
